title: TianGong Portal public navigation branches v1

countBasis.description: What each count counts. `public_versions` means distinct exact kind/id/version identities matching the request predicate; it is never a de-duplicated data-set count.

kind.description: The object-kind scope the counts were computed for. `all` keeps both kinds and is reported as-is.

parent.description: The requested branch node as a complete node. It carries its own `count`/`directCount`/`hasChildren` so a consumer can offer "this level only" versus "whole branch" without a second request. Null for a root page.

ancestors.description: Root-to-parent ancestors of the requested branch, excluding the parent itself, in root-first order. Identity only: a breadcrumb never needs counts. Empty for a root page.

nodes.description: The complete page of immediate children of `parent`. A page is bounded by the response byte budget, never by a hidden per-node cap; when more siblings remain, `nextCursor` is present.

description: One exact public-version branch page without whole-catalog totals. Scope, filters, node identity and cursor binding match public navigation v2.
